import pytest
import tomlkit

def test_nesting_table_in_inline_table_raises_error():
    t = tomlkit.table()
    t.append("a", 1)

    it = tomlkit.inline_table()

    with pytest.raises(tomlkit.exceptions.TOMLKitError, match="Inline tables cannot contain other tables"):
        it.append("table", t)
